id: 09_Donning and Doffing PPE in Clinical Laboratories Basic PPE for Routine Laborator
title: 基本防护装备的穿与脱（国内版）
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/09_Donning and Doffing PPE in Clinical Laboratories Basic PPE for Routine Laborator.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/09_Donning and Doffing PPE in Clinical Laboratories Basic PPE for Routine Laborator（国内版）/src.py

points.K2: 个人物品留在实验室外
points.K11: 重复使用的实验服挂指定处
points.K12: 污染的实验服卷起丢弃
points.S4: 实验服由单位统一清洗

shots.scene: 欣欣穿着白色实验服、戴着安全眼镜，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears a white lab coat and wraparound safety glasses and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲基本防护装备的穿与脱。
overlay: 基本防护装备的穿与脱

shots.scene: 实验服、手套、安全眼镜三个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a white lab coat, a pair of blue gloves and wraparound safety glasses. No people.
shots.narration: 穿得对，脱得更要对。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴着手表、拿着手机和咖啡杯，匆忙走向实验室门口
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, wearing a wristwatch and holding a phone and a coffee cup, hurries toward the lab door.
shots.narration: 阿杰赶着做实验，手表手机都没摘。

shots.scene: 实验结束，阿杰戴着手套直接去摘眼镜
shots.prompt_en: In the lab, the young male student still wears his gloves and reaches up to take off his safety glasses.
shots.narration: 做完实验，他戴着手套就去摘眼镜。

shots.scene: 小研抬手示意他停下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student raises her hand to stop him and shakes her head kindly.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：顺序错了，手套最脏。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 防护装备，穿脱都有讲究。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向衣架上的实验服、手套和安全眼镜
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to a white lab coat on a hanger, a pair of blue gloves and wraparound safety glasses on a bench.
shots.narration: 常规操作，先认识三件基本装备。

shots.scene: 安全眼镜特写，侧面护片高亮
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of wraparound safety glasses with the side shields highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 实验服、手套，加上带侧护的安全眼镜。

shots.section_title: 个人物品留在实验室外
shots.scene: 戒指、手表、手机、笔、包的图标放进实验室外的储物柜
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a ring, a wristwatch, a phone, a pen and a bag going into a locker outside a lab door. No people.
shots.narration: 先把首饰、手表摘下来。
overlay: 个人物品留在实验室外

shots.section_title: 个人物品留在实验室外
shots.scene: 阿杰把外套和背包放进门外的储物柜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts his jacket and backpack into a locker in the corridor outside the lab.
shots.narration: 外套、手机、笔和包，都放在实验室外。

shots.scene: 小研用发圈把长发束在脑后
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ties her long hair back into a ponytail with a hair tie.
shots.narration: 有长发的，把头发束起来。

shots.scene: 台面上摆着紧袖口实验服、一盒手套和安全眼镜
shots.prompt_en: A clean bench with a folded lab coat with knit cuffs, a box of gloves with a blank label and safety glasses. No people.
shots.narration: 备齐紧袖口实验服、手套和眼镜。

shots.scene: 小研对比两件不同大小的实验服
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up two lab coats of different sizes and picks the one that fits.
shots.narration: 实验服和手套，尺码要合身。

shots.scene: 放大镜检查实验服，破洞和缺扣处打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a lab coat; a torn spot and a missing snap are marked with red X icons. No people.
shots.narration: 穿前看一看，有没有撕裂、破洞、缺扣。

shots.scene: 有破洞的手套被放到一边，换一副新的
shots.prompt_en: A torn glove is set aside with a red X and a new pair of gloves is taken from the box. No people.
shots.narration: 有破损就换，不凑合。

shots.scene: 小研穿上实验服，把扣子一颗颗扣好
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on the lab coat and fastens every snap from collar to hem.
shots.narration: 第一步，穿上实验服，扣子全部扣好。

shots.scene: 小研戴上安全眼镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, in a fastened lab coat, puts on wraparound safety glasses.
shots.narration: 第二步，戴上安全眼镜。

shots.scene: 小研戴上手套，手套口盖住实验服袖口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls on blue gloves so the glove cuffs cover the knit sleeve cuffs of her coat.
shots.narration: 第三步，戴手套，手套口盖住袖口。

shots.scene: 衣、镜、手套三个图标用箭头连成顺序
shots.prompt_en: Three icons linked by arrows in order: lab coat, safety glasses, gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 记住顺序：衣、镜、手套。

shots.scene: 从深红到浅绿的渐变条，手套在最红一端
shots.prompt_en: A color bar from dark red to light green; a glove icon sits at the red end, a coat icon in the middle, glasses near the green end. No people.
shots.narration: 脱的顺序有不同做法。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着渐变条红色一端的手套
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the glove icon at the red end of the color bar.
shots.narration: 这里按从最脏到最干净的顺序来。

shots.scene: 小研双手戴手套，慢慢抬起
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slowly raises both gloved hands in front of her, calm and careful.
shots.narration: 先摘手套，动作要慢、要轻。

shots.scene: 拇指和食指成L形，捏起另一只手套的腕部外侧
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a gloved thumb and index finger form an L shape and pinch the outside of the other glove at the wrist. No people.
shots.narration: 用手指捏起另一只手套的腕部外侧。

shots.scene: 捏起时离开袖口，袖口被打勾保护
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the pinching fingers stay clear of the coat cuff; the clean cuff is marked with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 小心，脏手套别碰到实验服袖口。

shots.scene: 手套被整只拉下，翻成里朝外
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the glove is pulled off completely and ends up inside out in the other gloved hand. No people.
shots.narration: 整只拉下，手套就翻成里朝外。

shots.scene: 仍戴手套的手握住翻面手套
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the still gloved hand holds the inside-out glove balled in its palm. No people.
shots.narration: 把脱下的手套握在戴手套的手里。

shots.scene: 裸手的手指从手腕内侧伸进剩下的手套
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: two fingers of the bare hand slide under the cuff of the remaining glove on the inside of the wrist. No people.
shots.narration: 干净的手，从手腕内侧伸进去。

shots.scene: 手套向上翻出，把握着的那只包在里面
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the glove is peeled up and away from the wrist, turning inside out over the balled glove inside it. No people.
shots.narration: 向上、向外翻下，两只包成一团。

shots.scene: 裸手碰手套外表面的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand touching the outside of a dirty glove, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 干净的手，不碰手套外面。

shots.scene: 小研把手套团丢进感染性废物桶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student drops the balled gloves into a pedal bin lined with a bag and marked with a biohazard warning sign.
shots.narration: 手套丢进感染性废物容器。

shots.scene: 用过的手套放回盒子的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of used gloves being put back into a glove box, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 一次性手套，绝不重复使用。

shots.scene: 实验服外表面泛着淡淡的污染点，袖口是干净的
shots.prompt_en: A lab coat on a person-shaped outline; faint contamination dots on the front and sleeves, the knit cuffs shown clean. No people.
shots.narration: 实验服外面可能有污染，裸手别碰。

shots.scene: 手套盖住袖口的示意，袖口打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a glove covering a knit sleeve cuff, then the glove removed and the clean cuff marked with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 袖口一直被手套盖着，是干净的。

shots.scene: 小研解开实验服扣子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, with bare hands, unfastens the snaps of her lab coat.
shots.narration: 解开实验服的扣子。

shots.scene: 一只手捏住另一只袖口，把手臂抽出
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: one bare hand pinches the opposite knit cuff and pulls that arm out of the sleeve. No people.
shots.narration: 捏住一只袖口，把手臂抽出来。

shots.scene: 换手捏住另一只袖口抽出手臂
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the freed hand pinches the other cuff from inside and pulls the second arm out. No people.
shots.narration: 另一只手臂，同样捏袖口抽出。

shots.section_title: 重复使用的实验服挂指定处
shots.scene: 小研把实验服挂到实验室内的指定挂钩上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hangs the lab coat on a designated hook inside the lab, away from street clothes.
shots.narration: 可以再穿的实验服，挂到指定位置。
overlay: 重复使用的实验服挂指定处

shots.section_title: 污染的实验服卷起丢弃
shots.scene: 实验服下摆有一块明显污渍
shots.prompt_en: A lab coat with a clear stain near the lower pocket, with a yellow warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 有明显污染，或者需要丢弃时，
overlay: 污染的实验服卷起丢弃

shots.section_title: 污染的实验服卷起丢弃
shots.scene: 里面朝向自己，箭头示意向外折
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands hold the lab coat with its inside facing the person; arrows show folding the outside away. No people.
shots.narration: 里面朝向自己，向外折起来。

shots.section_title: 污染的实验服卷起丢弃
shots.scene: 实验服被卷成里朝外的一团
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the lab coat is rolled inside out into a tight bundle, the stain hidden inside. No people.
shots.narration: 里朝外卷成一团，脏面包在里面。

shots.section_title: 污染的实验服卷起丢弃
shots.scene: 衣服团放进感染性废物桶
shots.prompt_en: The rolled lab coat bundle goes into a lined pedal bin with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 丢进感染性废物容器。

shots.scene: 小研捏住太阳穴处的镜腿摘下眼镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student removes her safety glasses by holding the arms at her temples.
shots.narration: 摘眼镜，捏住太阳穴处的镜腿。

shots.scene: 镜片被标出污染点，镜腿打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of safety glasses: the lens front marked with contamination dots, the arms marked with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 镜腿沾污的可能小，别碰镜片。

shots.scene: 眼镜放进空白标签的待消毒托盘
shots.prompt_en: The safety glasses are placed in a tray with a blank label on a side shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 放到指定位置，下班前统一消毒。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手用湿巾擦拭眼镜，旁边是空白标签的消毒剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands wipe safety glasses with a damp cloth next to a disinfectant bottle with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 清洁眼镜也要戴手套。

shots.scene: 合格消毒剂瓶旁有一个计时沙漏
shots.prompt_en: A disinfectant bottle with a blank label and a green check, next to an hourglass icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用规定的消毒剂，作用时间要够。

shots.scene: 小研在洗手池用肥皂和流水洗手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student washes her hands with soap under running water at a lab sink.
shots.narration: 最后一步，用肥皂和流水洗手。

shots.scene: 手背、指缝、指甲下三处被圈出
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of two soapy hands with the backs, the spaces between fingers and under the nails circled. No people.
shots.narration: 手背、指缝、指甲下都要搓到。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标旁的泡沫双手
shots.prompt_en: Soapy hands rubbing together next to an hourglass icon. No people.
shots.narration: 认真揉搓，时间要够。

shots.scene: 速干手消毒剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: A pump bottle of alcohol hand rub with a blank label on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 暂时没有水，可先用速干手消毒剂。

shots.scene: 手消瓶指向洗手池的箭头
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from the hand rub bottle to a sink with running water. No people.
shots.narration: 有条件后，再尽快洗手。

shots.scene: 包头鞋打绿勾，凉鞋和拖鞋打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A closed-toe shoe with a solid upper marked with a green check; a sandal and a slipper crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里穿包头、鞋面不透水的鞋。

shots.scene: 欣欣手拿空白风险评估表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a clipboard with a blank risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 穿哪些防护，要看风险评估。

shots.scene: 老周和小研对着空白表格讨论
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student discuss a blank form at a desk.
shots.narration: 实验室和操作不同，防护也不同。

shots.scene: 平面图：穿戴区和脱卸区之间有隔断
shots.prompt_en: A simple floor plan with a clean donning area and a separate doffing area divided by a wall. No people.
shots.narration: 穿戴区和脱卸区要分开。

shots.scene: 干净衣物和脏防护用品分处两边
shots.prompt_en: Clean coats and bags on one side, used gloves and coats on the other side, separated by a line. No people.
shots.narration: 免得脏防护用品沾到干净物品。

shots.scene: 王老师指着墙上空白的流程图
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank procedure chart on a lab wall.
shots.narration: 各单位流程不同，按本单位规定做。

shots.scene: 穿实验服、戴手套的人走向办公室和食堂，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a person in a lab coat and gloves walking toward an office and a canteen, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验服、手套，不能穿出实验室。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手按门把手、电话、键盘，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a gloved hand touching a door handle, a telephone and a keyboard, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 戴着手套，不碰门把手、电话、键盘。

shots.scene: 实验台上的饮料和食物图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a drink cup and a sandwich on a lab bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里不吃喝，不放食物。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在洗手池旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a lab sink with soap and paper towels.
shots.narration: 什么时候必须洗手？

shots.scene: 三个时刻图标：摘手套、接触污染物、离开实验室
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with hand-wash symbols: removing gloves, touching a spill, leaving through the lab door. No people.
shots.narration: 摘手套后、碰污染后、离开前。

shots.scene: 六个小图依次示意掌心、手背、指缝、指背、拇指、指尖揉搓
shots.prompt_en: Six small hand-washing step diagrams in a row: palms, backs, between fingers, finger backs, thumbs, fingertips. No people.
shots.narration: 按六步揉搓，每个部位都照顾到。

shots.scene: 用纸巾关水龙头
shots.prompt_en: A clean hand uses a paper towel to turn off the faucet. No people.
shots.narration: 用纸巾擦干，再用纸巾关水龙头。

shots.scene: 手套指尖有破口，旁边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A gloved fingertip with a small tear and a yellow warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 工作中手套破了，

shots.scene: 小研停下操作，按方法摘下手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops her work, removes the torn gloves the safe way and drops them into a biohazard bin.
shots.narration: 立即停下，按方法摘掉。

shots.scene: 洗手后戴上新手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student washes her hands and puts on a new pair of gloves.
shots.narration: 洗手后换新手套，再继续。

shots.scene: 手套上有明显沾污的图标，箭头指向新手套
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a visibly soiled glove with an arrow pointing to a fresh glove. No people.
shots.narration: 手套明显沾污，也要马上换。

shots.section_title: 实验服由单位统一清洗
shots.scene: 实验服装进家用洗衣机的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lab coat going into a home washing machine, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验服不要带回家洗。
overlay: 实验服由单位统一清洗

shots.section_title: 实验服由单位统一清洗
shots.scene: 实验服装进空白标签的密封袋，送去统一处理
shots.prompt_en: A lab coat is sealed in a bag with a blank label and placed on a collection cart. No people.
shots.narration: 装袋后由单位统一消毒、清洗。

shots.scene: 阿杰手背沾到液体，赶到洗手池冲洗
shots.prompt_en: The young male student notices liquid on the back of his hand and rinses it under running water at the sink.
shots.narration: 皮肤沾到样品，立即用流水冲洗。

shots.scene: 洗眼器标志和正在出水的洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash sign above a lab eyewash station with water flowing. No people.
shots.narration: 溅进眼睛，马上到洗眼器冲洗。

shots.scene: 阿杰向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports to the older man at the lab doorway; the older man listens and nods.
shots.narration: 冲洗后报告实验室负责人。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁有红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 按要求就医评估，紧急拨打120。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现储物柜、束发、放大镜图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a locker, a hair tie and a magnifying glass.
shots.narration: 摘物品、束头发、查装备。

shots.scene: 衣、镜、手套顺序图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lab coat, safety glasses and gloves linked by arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 穿：实验服、眼镜、手套。

shots.scene: 手套、实验服、眼镜、洗手的顺序图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons linked by arrows: gloves, lab coat, safety glasses, hand washing at a sink. No people.
shots.narration: 脱：手套、实验服、眼镜，再洗手。

shots.scene: 门、电话、工作台图标，手套被挡在门内
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lab door with gloves and a lab coat staying inside, a phone and an office outside. No people.
shots.narration: 防护用品不出门，破了脏了马上换。

shots.scene: 欣欣洗完手，挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot dries its paws with a paper towel by the sink and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 穿脱有序，平安实验，下次见！
